input_contract.input: exact 270bp genomic insert = raw[15:285] of the author synthetic oligo (300bp=FWD15+270+REV15)
input_contract.PARM_padding: official central zero-padding to L_max=600 (bare FASTA)
input_contract.H1_input: same 270bp insert, full-sequence 4/5-mer spectrum kernel (forward only)

labels.primary: MPRAnalyze getAlpha activity (condition V1; uq depth factors; 3 DNA + 3 RNA aggregate)
labels.kept_labels: all (zero/negative/NA/nonsignificant kept); no activity-threshold or p-value selection
labels.note: apparently all-positive alpha; VERIFIED here, not enforced

model_assets.GC_baseline: GC fraction of the 270bp insert (higher GC -> higher activity, no fitted sign)

groups.definition: label-free overlapping-270bp-window components (step90 merge per chromosome) + merge of shared exact/RC inserts where actually recovered

dedup.note: at most 7622 unique sequences scored once per model; dedup by sequence SHA

design_only_excluded.role: retained as counts only; excluded from performance

metric_plan.primary: pooled 7537 finite bio Spearman(alpha, pred) for PARM, H1, GC; paired rho differences
metric_plan.no_cross_unit: no MAE/R2/log of PARM across output units; no calibration
metric_plan.gc_null: constant or undefined GC -> null with reason (not 0)
metric_plan.top_decile: k=ceil(0.1*n); deterministic ID tie-break; precision/enrichment vs same-alpha ranks; report true/pred ties
metric_plan.per_component: rho for components with >=10 finite/nonconstant rows; macro-average + n_eligible + size histogram
metric_plan.bootstrap: paired 2000 component-resampling (with multiplicity) for rho/delta-rho/top10 if >=30 eligible components; CONDITIONAL uncertainty (residual regional dependence)
metric_plan.loco: leave-one-chromosome-out pooled rho sensitivity (NO FITS); no formal chromosome CI
metric_plan.controls: n=85 descriptive score-vs-alpha + ranked distribution only; not mixed into primary rho
disclose: retrospective transfer, not prospective or strict new family

supported_if_all: PARM minus H1 rho >= 0.05 with conditional paired-difference CI lo > 0
PARM top10 precision >= H1 top10 precision
PARM non-chr17 rho > 0 with no audit failure
decision_rule.not_a_promotion: operational resource decision only; does not replace old H1 MAE10% gate / local D28 FAIL

readout_assets.parm: official PARM HEK293 5 folds (restrictive license; local academic use; no redistribution)
readout_assets.h1: batch24 fixed spectrum-kernel ridge readouts (inference only; existing weights)
